mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% signals tightening monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS stays above 2% for 6 months but returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05 in t-test), or if other factors (e.g., GDP growth) offset the effect.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time crossing of FEDFUNDS below 1.5% triggers a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to expectations of prolonged easing and reduced interest rate pressures.
failure_condition: If the FEDFUNDS crosses below 1.5% but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or if the signal reverses within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE below 4% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate labor market stability and lower inflation expectations.
failure_condition: If UNRATE stays below 4% for 6 months but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or if the signal reverses within 10 days.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling FEDFUNDS and rising GDPC1 signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, both driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression, or if the proxies move in opposite directions during the period.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion regime, rising GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate sustained growth and reduced risk.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises in a late-cycle regime but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or if the regime ends before the signal's horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO above 110 (2017=100 baseline) signals robust supply-side growth, reducing inflationary pressures and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO stays above 110 for 6 months but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or if supply-side factors offset the effect.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS signals improving labor market conditions, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate stability.
failure_condition: If the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression, or if the proxies move in opposite directions during the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% over 60 trading days triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as investors anticipate prolonged easing and reduced discount rates.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS averages below 1.5% for 60 days but returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or if the signal reverses before the horizon.
